chunks: Hadith 2314 — And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said on the day of the conquest of Mecca:
"Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, sanctified Mecca
on the day He created the heavens and the earth
So it is sacred until the Hour is established. It was not made lawful for anyone before me, nor will it be made lawful for anyone after me. It was only made lawful for me for one hour of the day."

key_terms.السَّاعَةُ: the Hour, meaning the Day of Resurrection
key_terms.السَّمَاوَاتِ: the heavens, mentioned in connection with creation
key_terms.الْأَرْضَ: the earth, paired with the heavens in the creation formula
key_terms.تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى: Blessed and Exalted; a formula of glorification for Allah in this context
key_terms.سَاعَةً: a limited hour or brief period of time

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the sanctity of Mecca and its legal status?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Mecca was made sacred by Allah from the very beginning of creation and that its sanctity remains until the Day of Resurrection. It also affirms the unique and temporary permission granted to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم during the conquest of Mecca, highlighting the enduring legal and sacred status of the sanctuary.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2314 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said on the day of the conquest of Mecca:
"Indeed, Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, sanctified Mecca
'on the day He created the heavens and the earth.'
It is sacred until the Day of Resurrection. It was not made lawful for anyone before me, nor will it be made lawful for anyone after me. It was only made lawful for me for one hour of the day."
